run_stable_micro.py.text:
"""Prepare stable model-free component gates. Default plan starts no child.

Root compiles the three binaries separately. Execution is sequential ABBA,
with active >=0.5s warmup and seven >=100ms samples in every process. A gate
requires >=5% pooled speedup AND <=5% drift between each binary's two process
medians. This script never edits runtime allowlists or selects a model winner.
The default twelve cases cover nv1/3/5; --all-nv covers nv1..9 in 36 cases.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import ctypes
import datetime as dt
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import statistics
import subprocess
import time

FOLDER = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = FOLDER.parents[4]
DEFAULT_CASES = [(kind, cols, rows, nv, 8)
    for kind, cols, rows in ((12, 2048, 512), (12, 512, 2048),
                             (214, 512, 2048), (14, 512, 2048))
    for nv in (1, 3, 5)]
ALL_NV_CASES = [(kind, cols, rows, nv, 8)
    for kind, cols, rows in ((12, 2048, 512), (12, 512, 2048),
                             (214, 512, 2048), (14, 512, 2048))
    for nv in range(1, 10)]
BINARIES = {"baseline": "bench-stable-baseline.exe", "generic": "bench-stable-generic.exe",
            "specialized": "bench-stable-specialized.exe", "control": "bench-stable-generic.exe"}


def sha(path):
    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        return hashlib.file_digest(handle, "sha256").hexdigest()


def identity(path):
    result = {"path": str(path), "exists": path.is_file()}
    if result["exists"]:
        result.update(bytes=path.stat().st_size, sha256=sha(path))
    return result


def write_json(path, value):
    temporary = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".part")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    temporary.replace(path)


def strict_json(text):
    def bad(value):
        raise ValueError("nonfinite JSON number: " + value)
    def floating(value):
        number = float(value)
        return number if math.isfinite(number) else bad(value)
    return json.loads(text, parse_constant=bad, parse_float=floating)


def source_identities():
    paths = [FOLDER / "bench_panels_stable.c", Path(__file__).resolve(),
             FOLDER / "quant-specialized.c", FOLDER / "panel_neon_specialized.h",
             FOLDER.parent / "baseline-libjanas.a"]
    paths += [ROOT / name for name in (
        "src/llm/matvec.c", "src/llm/matvec.h", "src/llm/quant.c", "src/llm/quant.h",
        "src/llm/quant_panel.c", "src/llm/quant_panel.h", "src/llm/quant_neon.h",
        "src/llm/quant_neon_k.h", "src/llm/quant_neon_panel.h",
        "src/common/pool.h", "src/common/sysinfo.h", "src/common/cpu_features.h")]
    return [identity(path) for path in paths]


def validate_result(data, case, label, candidate, baseline="baseline"):
    if not isinstance(data, dict) or type(data.get("schema")) is not int or data["schema"] != 1:
        raise ValueError("wrong component result schema")
    shape_keys = ("type", "cols", "rows", "nv", "threads")
    if (any(type(data.get(key)) is not int for key in shape_keys) or
        tuple(data[key] for key in shape_keys) != tuple(case)):
        raise ValueError("reported shape/thread controls differ from requested case")
    matrices = 2 if tuple(case[:3]) == (12, 2048, 512) else 1
    if data.get("matrices") != matrices or data.get("exact") is not True:
        raise ValueError("wrong matrix count or failed exact scalar comparison")
    if type(data.get("warmup_iterations")) is not int or data["warmup_iterations"] < 1:
        raise ValueError("missing active warmup iterations")
    warmup = data.get("warmup_elapsed_seconds")
    if isinstance(warmup, bool) or not isinstance(warmup, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(warmup) or warmup < .5:
        raise ValueError("active warmup shorter than 0.5 seconds")
    values = [data.get(name) for name in ("samples_seconds", "sample_elapsed_seconds", "sample_iterations")]
    if any(not isinstance(value, list) or len(value) != 7 for value in values):
        raise ValueError("expected seven sample records")
    for seconds, elapsed, iterations in zip(*values):
        if (isinstance(seconds, bool) or not isinstance(seconds, (int, float)) or
            not math.isfinite(seconds) or seconds <= 0 or isinstance(elapsed, bool) or
            not isinstance(elapsed, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(elapsed) or elapsed < .1 or
            type(iterations) is not int or iterations < 1 or
            not math.isclose(seconds, elapsed / iterations, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-15)):
            raise ValueError("invalid elapsed/iteration/mean sample")
    if label == "B" or baseline == "control":
        if data.get("dispatch_counters_available") != 1:
            raise ValueError("candidate dispatch counters unavailable")
        keys = ("actual_prepared_rows", "actual_prepared_row_vectors", "established_rows",
                "established_row_vectors", "panel_views", "panel_unique", "panel_dedup_hits", "panel_bytes")
        if any(type(data.get(key)) is not int or data[key] < 0 for key in keys):
            raise ValueError("invalid candidate dispatch counters")
        if data["actual_prepared_rows"] + data["established_rows"] != matrices * case[2]:
            raise ValueError("row counters do not cover the complete group")
        if data["actual_prepared_row_vectors"] + data["established_row_vectors"] != matrices * case[2] * case[3]:
            raise ValueError("row-vector counters do not cover the complete group")
        if (data["actual_prepared_row_vectors"] != data["actual_prepared_rows"] * case[3] or
            data["established_row_vectors"] != data["established_rows"] * case[3]):
            raise ValueError("rows and row-vectors disagree")
        if data["panel_bytes"] > 8 << 20:
            raise ValueError("panel workspace exceeds 8 MiB")
        preparation = data.get("panel_prepare_seconds")
        if (isinstance(preparation, bool) or not isinstance(preparation, (int, float)) or
            not math.isfinite(preparation) or preparation < 0 or
            data.get("dispatch_counter_scope") != "final_completed_group"):
            raise ValueError("invalid panel preparation time or counter scope")
        if label == "A" or candidate == "control":
            if data.get("panels_enabled") != 0 or data["actual_prepared_rows"] != 0:
                raise ValueError("control unexpectedly executed prepared dispatch")
        elif data.get("panels_enabled") != 1 or data["actual_prepared_rows"] <= 0:
            raise ValueError("candidate completed no prepared rows")


def process_environment(candidate, label):
    inherited = dict(os.environ)
    env = {key: value for key, value in inherited.items() if not key.upper().startswith("JANAS_")}
    controlled = None
    if label == "B" and candidate != "control":
        controlled = env["JANAS_CPU_TILES"] = "1"
    return env, {"removed_inherited_janas_key_names": sorted(
                    key for key in inherited if key.upper().startswith("JANAS_")),
                 "controlled_JANAS_CPU_TILES": controlled,
                 "parent_environment_preserved": dict(os.environ) == inherited}


def windows_affinity():
    from ctypes import wintypes
    kernel = ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32", use_last_error=True)
    kernel.GetCurrentProcess.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
    kernel.GetProcessAffinityMask.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_size_t), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_size_t)]
    kernel.SetProcessAffinityMask.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE, ctypes.c_size_t]
    kernel.GetProcessAffinityMask.restype = kernel.SetProcessAffinityMask.restype = wintypes.BOOL
    process = kernel.GetCurrentProcess()
    original, system = ctypes.c_size_t(), ctypes.c_size_t()
    if not kernel.GetProcessAffinityMask(process, ctypes.byref(original), ctypes.byref(system)):
        raise ctypes.WinError(ctypes.get_last_error())
    if system.value & 255 != 255:
        raise RuntimeError("CPUs 0..7 unavailable; this protocol requires exact affinity 0xff")
    return kernel, process, original.value, system.value


def run_child(command, env, affinity, timeout):
    from ctypes import wintypes
    kernel, parent, original, system = affinity
    if not kernel.SetProcessAffinityMask(parent, 255):
        raise ctypes.WinError(ctypes.get_last_error())
    child = None
    try:
        child = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                                 stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        actual, child_system = ctypes.c_size_t(), ctypes.c_size_t()
        if not kernel.GetProcessAffinityMask(wintypes.HANDLE(int(child._handle)), ctypes.byref(actual), ctypes.byref(child_system)):
            raise ctypes.WinError(ctypes.get_last_error())
        if actual.value != 255:
            raise RuntimeError("child did not inherit exact 0xff affinity")
    except BaseException:
        if child is not None:
            child.kill()
            child.communicate()
        raise
    finally:
        if not kernel.SetProcessAffinityMask(parent, original):
            if child is not None:
                child.kill()
                child.communicate()
            raise ctypes.WinError(ctypes.get_last_error())
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        stdout, stderr = child.communicate(timeout=timeout)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        child.kill()
        child.communicate()
        raise
    return child.returncode, stdout, stderr, {
        "parent_original_affinity": hex(original), "system_affinity": hex(system),
        "child_affinity": "0xff", "child_wait_wall_seconds": time.monotonic() - started}


def summarize_runs(runs, candidate):
    medians = [statistics.median(run["result"]["samples_seconds"]) for run in runs]
    baseline = [sample for run in runs if run["label"] == "A" for sample in run["result"]["samples_seconds"]]
    changed = [sample for run in runs if run["label"] == "B" for sample in run["result"]["samples_seconds"]]
    a1, b1, b2, a2 = medians
    drift_a = max(a1, a2) / min(a1, a2) - 1
    drift_b = max(b1, b2) / min(b1, b2) - 1
    speedup = statistics.median(baseline) / statistics.median(changed)
    stable = drift_a <= .05 and drift_b <= .05
    return {"process_order": "ABBA", "process_median_seconds": medians,
            "baseline_A1_over_A2": a1 / a2, "candidate_B1_over_B2": b1 / b2,
            "baseline_relative_process_drift": drift_a, "candidate_relative_process_drift": drift_b,
            "both_process_drifts_at_most_5pct": stable,
            "pooled_baseline_to_candidate_seconds_ratio": speedup,
            "pooled_speedup_at_least_5pct": speedup >= 1.05,
            "component_gate": candidate != "control" and stable and speedup >= 1.05,
            "control_only": candidate == "control", "automatic_promotion": False}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    mode = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    mode.add_argument("--plan", action="store_true", help="default: inspect staged identities and cases; launch nothing")
    mode.add_argument("--execute", action="store_true", help="explicitly run sequential native Windows ARM64 children")
    parser.add_argument("--candidate", choices=("generic", "specialized", "control"), default="generic")
    parser.add_argument("--baseline", choices=("baseline", "control"), default="baseline",
                        help="frozen old wrapper, or current statistics-enabled generic with tiles unset")
    selection = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    selection.add_argument("--case", action="append", help="type:cols:rows:nv:threads; repeatable, threads1..8")
    selection.add_argument("--all-nv", action="store_true", help="all four format/geometry families at nv1..9 (36 cases)")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=120)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    cases = ([tuple(int(value) for value in text.split(":")) for text in args.case]
             if args.case else list(ALL_NV_CASES if args.all_nv else DEFAULT_CASES))
    if (not math.isfinite(args.timeout) or args.timeout <= 0 or not cases or
        len(set(cases)) != len(cases) or any(len(case) != 5 or case[0] not in (12, 14, 214) or
        case[1] <= 0 or case[1] % 256 or case[2] <= 0 or not 1 <= case[3] <= 9 or not 1 <= case[4] <= 8 for case in cases)):
        parser.error("invalid timeout or distinct component case")
    binary_paths = {"A": FOLDER / BINARIES[args.baseline], "B": FOLDER / BINARIES[args.candidate]}
    binaries = {label: identity(path) for label, path in binary_paths.items()}
    sources = source_identities()
    manifest = {"schema": 1, "created_utc": dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "scope": "model-free allocation+packing+pool+candidate-statistics inclusive O2 component gate; not model throughput",
        "baseline": args.baseline, "candidate": args.candidate, "cases": cases, "process_order": "ABBA",
        "planned_processes": 4 * len(cases), "samples_per_process": 7,
        "active_warmup_minimum_seconds": .5, "sample_minimum_seconds": .1,
        "required_parent_and_child_affinity": "0xff", "binaries": binaries, "sources": sources,
        "source_identity_boundary": "source snapshot is not proof of binary build provenance; root records compiler commands separately",
        "control_semantics": "baseline control uses current statistics-enabled generic with tiles unset; candidate control also uses generic unset; generic/specialized candidates use tiles1; all inherited JANAS_ keys cleared",
        "automatic_promotion": False, "results": []}
    manifest["staged_identity_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(
        {"binaries": binaries, "sources": sources}, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest()
    if not args.execute:
        print(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, allow_nan=False))
        return 0
    if os.name != "nt" or platform.machine().lower() not in ("arm64", "aarch64"):
        raise RuntimeError("Execution requires native ARM64 Windows Python")
    if any(not value["exists"] for value in binaries.values()):
        raise RuntimeError("Root must compile the selected stable component binaries first")
    if binaries["A"]["sha256"] == binaries["B"]["sha256"] and args.candidate == "control":
        raise RuntimeError("Identical baseline/candidate executables with the same unset tile policy")
    output = args.output or FOLDER / ("stable-micro-" + args.candidate + "-" + dt.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S") + ".json")
    if output.exists():
        raise FileExistsError("Preserve existing evidence; choose a new --output path")
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    original_environment = dict(os.environ)
    affinity = windows_affinity()
    try:
        for case in cases:
            runs = []
            for index, label in enumerate("ABBA"):
                for binary in binaries.values():
                    if sha(Path(binary["path"])) != binary["sha256"]:
                        raise RuntimeError("Component executable changed during the gate")
                if source_identities() != sources:
                    raise RuntimeError("Component source snapshot changed during the gate")
                env, controlled = process_environment(args.candidate, label)
                command = [str(binary_paths[label]), *map(str, case)]
                code, stdout, stderr, process = run_child(command, env, affinity, args.timeout)
                if code:
                    raise RuntimeError(f"{label} case {case} failed ({code}):\n{stdout}\n{stderr}")
                result = strict_json(stdout)
                validate_result(result, case, label, args.candidate, args.baseline)
                runs.append({"label": label, "process_index": index, "command": command,
                             "environment": controlled, "process": process,
                             "stdout": stdout, "stderr": stderr, "result": result})
            row = {"case": case, "runs": runs, **summarize_runs(runs, args.candidate)}
            manifest["results"].append(row)
            manifest["parent_environment_preserved"] = dict(os.environ) == original_environment
            write_json(output, manifest)
            print(json.dumps({"case": case, "candidate": args.candidate,
                              "speedup": row["pooled_baseline_to_candidate_seconds_ratio"],
                              "stable": row["both_process_drifts_at_most_5pct"],
                              "component_gate": row["component_gate"]}), flush=True)
    finally:
        kernel, process, original, _ = affinity
        if not kernel.SetProcessAffinityMask(process, original):
            raise ctypes.WinError(ctypes.get_last_error())
        if dict(os.environ) != original_environment:
            raise RuntimeError("Parent environment changed unexpectedly")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
